result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the LOC of repositories committed to in the past 90 days, not the 180-day figure.

The bug was in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java` at line 120. The block formatted `loc180Days` but took its percentage from `loc90Days`. I changed that one reference to `loc90Days`, so the LOC, the percentage and the repository count now all use the 90-day figures.

The reports module compiles offline and its test suite passes with no failures. No existing test covers this section, so the fix itself is verified by reading the code, not by a test. Nothing is committed.
